native_findings: FontManager::drawCharacter writes native glyph pixels via Segment::setPixelColorXY and supports flat or two-color vertical gradient fills; it has no alpha parameter or built-in entry/exit lifecycle.
Segment::blendPixelColorXY exists in the pinned WLED source and blends a new color against the segment pixel.
Current HBNF overlay is drawn over a newly rendered base frame each frame; overlay TTL expiry reveals the next base frame.
